This pull request refactors the `cmd_query` and `cmd_summary` functions in `coderabbit-collector-helper.sh` by extracting common logic into several new helper functions (`_query_build_where`, `_query_print_text`, `_summary_print_severity`, `_summary_print_categories`, `_summary_print_files`, `_summary_print_runs`) to improve modularity and readability.
